title: Student societies and sports at the University of Edinburgh
description:
University isn’t just lectures and libraries, it’s where you find your people. 

At the University of Edinburgh, there are 540+ student‑run societies, sports clubs and teams waiting for you - a chance to try something new or go all‑in on what you love. 

Think cultural and international communities, academic and career networks, music, drama and creative arts, volunteering and campaigning. Plus, every kind of sport, from beginner sessions to performance sport, for athletes competing at the highest level.  

Run by students, for students through the Edinburgh University Students’ Association (EUSA) and the Edinburgh University Sports Union (EUSU), our clubs and societies are where ideas come to life, teammates become friends, and hobbies become skills employers notice. 

You’ll build confidence, explore our city, and make extraordinary memories and friends that last long after graduation. 

Ready to join us? Discover what you could be part of when you study at Edinburgh ➡️ https://edin.ac/45BLFSb 

#EUSA #EUSU #universityofedinburgh #edinburgh #studentlife #societies

title: What's it like to build the future? Join UBC Engineering to do just that.
description:
What's it like to build the future? Join UBC Engineering to do just that. 

From day one you'll be designing, testing, building and making.
You'll be applying you knowledge to come up with something new. Using the design process to solve open ended problems and turning fundamental principles, into real world solutions.

While you build the future, build your future at UBC Engineering.
